subject.title: fix(anthropic): accept Claude CLI apiKeyHelper auth

question: Should OpenClaw adopt Claude Code's helper-first credential precedence and resolve this branch's current conflicts for landing?
rationale: The implementation is contract-backed and well proven, but it intentionally changes which credential source wins in mixed local auth states, making final compatibility ownership a maintainer choice.

options.title: Accept Helper-First Precedence
